items.title: Why NXP Semiconductors Stock Dropped 18.5% in July
items.summary: The Dutch-American chipmaker beat Street estimates on both lines in Q2 2026. The stock fell anyway.

items.title: Why One Prominent Analyst Expects 85% Returns for ON Semiconductor Despite Current Turmoil
items.summary: ON Semiconductor just posted a clean earnings beat, yet its stock sits nearly 40% below its 52-week high while one top analyst sees a radically different story unfolding in the quarters ahead.

items.title: The companies emerging as new leaders in this renewed AI rally
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre examines the comeback seen across the semiconductor landscape over the past five trading days, while also analyzing which companies are emerging as leaders in the renewed AI rally.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Retakes Key Level As Chip Stocks Waver
items.summary: Chip stocks were a mixed bag on Monday as the Philadelphia semiconductor index, known as SOX, seesawed. However, Nvidia stock retook a key support level. On the stock market today, the SOX rose just over 1%.

items.title: NXP downgraded by UBS as China and AI risks cloud growth
items.summary: NXP Semiconductor NV (NASDAQ:NXPI) was downgraded by UBS as the investment bank warned that a potential automotive inventory correction in China and limited exposure to artificial intelligence data centres could constrain growth. Its rating was cut to 'neutral' from 'buy', with the price...

items.title: UBS downgrades NXP to Neutral on China auto risks, trims PT to $270
items.summary: Investing.com -- UBS downgraded NXP Semiconductors to Neutral from Buy, arguing that while the analog semiconductor upcycle is gaining momentum, the company's growth outlook is becoming less compelling due to rising risks of a China automotive inventory correction and relatively limited exposure to AI infrastructure spending.

items.title: GlobalFoundries Stock Costs More Than The Market On Earnings And Less On Cash Flow
items.summary: The chipmaker looks dear on profits and slightly cheap on cash, and what sits under that gap is a business that turns far more of each sales dollar into cash than into profit while it swaps a shrinking handset exposure for faster end markets in data centers and automotive.

items.title: Here Are Monday’s Top Wall Street Analyst Research Calls: Best Buy, Circle Internet, Corning, Eaton Corporation, eBay, Ingersoll-Rand, NXP Semiconductors, Starbucks, and More
items.summary: Wall Street analysts are reshuffling their bets heading into August, and some of the calls on Monday target names that range from a crypto giant to a coffee behemoth to a semiconductor darling. Find out which stocks just got slapped with new downgrades and which ones earned fresh upgrades.
